cd /home/jimmybones/Dokumente/OpenGym-HomeAssistant && python3 -m py_compile custom_components/opengym/*.py && echo COMPILE_OK && /tmp/oglogo/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys, types, importlib.util
from datetime import date
pkg = types.ModuleType("og"); pkg.__path__=["custom_components/opengym"]
sys.modules["og"] = pkg
const = types.ModuleType("og.const")
for k, v in {"DOMAIN":"opengym","MUSCLES":{"chest":"Chest","deltoids":"Shoulders","abs":"Core","hamstring":"Hamstrings"},"RECOVERY_DAYS":2,"SCAN_INTERVAL":None,"DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL":15}.items():
    setattr(const,k,v)
sys.modules["og.const"]=const
for name in ["homeassistant","homeassistant.core","homeassistant.helpers","homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator","homeassistant.helpers.aiohttp_client","aiohttp"]:
    sys.modules[name]=types.ModuleType(name)
class DUCE:
    def __init__(self,*a,**k): pass
    def __class_getitem__(cls,item): return cls
    def async_set_updated_data(self,d): pass
    def async_update_listeners(self): pass
sys.modules["homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator"].DataUpdateCoordinator = DUCE
sys.modules["homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator"].UpdateFailed = Exception
sys.modules["homeassistant.core"].HomeAssistant = object
sys.modules["homeassistant.core"].callback = lambda f: f
api = types.ModuleType("og.api"); api.OpenGymApiClient=object; api.OpenGymError=Exception; api.OpenGymConnectionError=Exception
sys.modules["og.api"]=api
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("og.coordinator","custom_components/opengym/coordinator.py")
co = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(co)

state = {
  "unit":"kg",
  "targetW": 78.0,
  "workouts":[{"id":"w1","d":"2026-11-10","name":"Push","vol":100,
    "entries":[{"id":"1254","sets":[{"w":80,"r":5,"hr":142},{"w":82.5,"r":3,"hr":150}]}]}],
  "bodyweight":[{"d":"2026-11-12","w":80.4}],
  "exWeights":{"1254":{"w":82.5,"d":"2026-11-10"},"1010":{"w":100}},
}
s = co.OpenGymState(state)
assert s.goal_weight()==78.0
assert s.last_workout_day()==date(2026,11,10)
pr = s.pr_map(); assert pr["1254"]["weight"]==82.5 and pr["1010"]["weight"]==100
hr = s.last_workout_hr(); assert hr=={"avg":146.0,"max":150.0}, hr

# settings.unterpfad + fehlende werte
s2 = co.OpenGymState({"settings":{"targetW":75}})
assert s2.goal_weight()==75
s3 = co.OpenGymState({})
assert s3.goal_weight() is None and s3.pr_map()=={} and s3.last_workout_hr() is None and s3.last_workout_day() is None
print("NEW_FEATURE_TESTS_OK")
EOF
